description: Defines classes and structures related to kernel specifications and partition information for JIT code generation in PyTorch, including KernelSpec and PartitionInfo.

classes.name: PartitionInfo
classes.description: Contains partitioning details such as number of sub-tensors and partition dimension.

classes.name: KernelSpec
classes.description: Represents a device-independent kernel configuration, including graph, code, input info, and kernel cache.

methods.name: PartitionInfo
methods.description: Constructor initializing number of sub-tensors and dimension.

methods.name: KernelSpec
methods.description: Constructor initializing kernel with key and graph, analyzing nodes for randomness and input types.

methods.name: nTensorInputs
methods.description: Returns the number of tensor inputs.

methods.name: hasRandom
methods.description: Indicates if the graph contains random operations.

methods.name: findKernel
methods.description: Retrieves a cached kernel based on argument specification.

methods.name: cacheKernel
methods.description: Caches a kernel for a given argument specification.
